# 🏷️ Recommended GitHub Repository Topics & Tags

To maximize repository discovery and reach open-source developers and Windows users looking for battery monitoring tools, the following tags should be added under **About -> Topics** on the GitHub repository page (`https://github.com/Kaandonmez/BluetoothBatteryMonitor`):

### 🎯 Primary Topics
- `windows-11`
- `windows-10`
- `bluetooth`
- `battery-monitor`
- `fluent-design`
- `wpf`
- `dotnet8`
- `csharp`
- `system-tray`

### 🎧 Hardware & Peripheral Topics
- `airpods-windows`
- `galaxy-buds`
- `sony-headphones`
- `logitech-ghub`
- `bluetooth-battery`
- `tws-earbuds`
- `dualshock-battery`
- `dualsense-windows`

### 🛠️ Feature & Architecture Topics
- `rest-api`
- `audio-router`

- `open-source`
- `hacktoberfest`

---

### 📋 How to apply on GitHub:
1. Navigate to `https://github.com/Kaandonmez/BluetoothBatteryMonitor`.
2. Click the ⚙️ gear icon next to **About** on the top right.
3. In the **Topics** field, paste the keywords listed above separated by spaces.
4. Set the repository description:
   > *Modern Fluent Design Windows 10/11 system tray app for real-time Bluetooth battery telemetry (AirPods, Galaxy Buds, Sony, Logitech), audio codec detection, and local REST API.*
5. Save changes.
